meta.subject: 英语一
meta.note: 取材于 2026-09-26 前后改过的 English/translation&writing/作文/好词佳句.md（第 5、13 节）。ENG-WRITE-02-05 高级句式此前 0 张卡。考的是写作输出时的语法硬伤与加分句式，不含时效性内容。

cards.q: 大作文里要表达「如果那名球员相信自己，他就不会射失那个关键点球」，下列哪个句子语法正确且是加分句式：
opts: If the player would have believed in himself, he would not have missed the crucial penalty.
Had the player to believe in himself, he would not have missed the crucial penalty.
Had the player believed in himself, he would not have missed the crucial penalty.
If the player had believed in himself, he would not miss the crucial penalty.
cards.exp: 与过去事实相反：从句 had done、主句 would have done；省略 if 时须把 had 提到主语前 → Had the player believed in himself, ...。常见错法：在 if 条件句里写 would have（阅卷判语法硬伤）；把倒装的 Had 误写成 had to（不得不）；从句用了 had done、主句却写成 would do（与过去事实不匹配）。同族可直接套用的虚拟倒装加分句：Were we to trade the environment for short-term gains, we would pay a far heavier price in the future.（Were 前置 = If we were to...）。
traps: 在条件从句里使用 would have believed
省略 if 时忘了把 had 提前，或误补成 had to
与过去事实相反却把主句写成 would not miss
